'''Dylan Borso''' (born June 2, 2006) is an American professional [[soccer]] player who plays as wing-back for [[Major League Soccer]] club [[Chicago Fire FC|Chicago Fire]].  Borso is currently on loan with [[Greenock Morton F.C.]] in the [[Scottish Championship]] through Jan 2027.

==Youth and College Career==
Borso is a youth product of Chicago Fire MLS Academy since 2017. He scored his first professional goal in his first start with [[Chicago Fire FC II|reserves]] on Sept. 10, 2023 and was named MLS Next Pro Rising Star of Matchday 26.<ref>{{Cite web |last=II |first=Chicago Fire FC |title=Fire Academy Product Dylan Borso Named MLS NEXT Pro Rising Star of Matchday 26 |url=https://www.chicagofirefc.com/two/news/fire-academy-product-dylan-borso-named-mls-next-pro-rising-star-of-matchday-26 |access-date=2026-07-17 |website=Chicago Fire FC II |language=en}}</ref>

The highest ranked college commit in America for the Class of 2024 ... Borso attended Wake Forest for one semester recording a team-high assists  ... Was named an ACC All-Freshman Team selection ... TDS Top 5 National Freshman  ... Tallied an assist on Wake Forest’s game-winning goal against Syracuse (Nov. 6) in the first round of the ACC Tournament ... Recorded goals in NCAA Tournament victories against Maryland (Nov. 24) and Clemson (Dec. 1), as his strike against the Tigers 67 seconds into overtime eliminated the defending National Champions.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://godeacs.com/sports/mens-soccer/roster/dylan-borso/8242|title=Dylan Borso - Men's Soccer|website=Wake Forest University Athletics|access-date=2026-10-02}}</ref>

==Club career==
Borso signed a [[Homegrown Player Rule (MLS)|Homegrown Contract]] with the [[Chicago Fire FC|Chicago Fire]] on December 20, 2024, until 2027 with options for 2028 and 2029. He debuted with the senior Chicago Fire team in a 1–1 fixture against Columbus Crew on Mar 7, 2026 <ref>{{Cite web |last=chicagofirefc |title=Match Recap {{!}} Chicago Fire FC Earns Clean Sheet on the Road against Columbus Crew {{!}} Chicago Fire FC |url=https://www.chicagofirefc.com/news/match-recap-chicago-fire-fc-earns-clean-sheet-on-the-road-against-columbus-crew |access-date=2026-07-17 |website=chicagofirefc |language=en}}</ref> in the 28th minute of the match, winning Man-of-the Match game ball honors<ref>{{Cite news |date=2026-03-09 |title=Chicago Fire FC (@ChicagoFire) on X |url=https://x.com/ChicagoFire/status/2031090596337668210 |access-date=2026-07-17 |work=X (formerly Twitter) |language=en-US}}</ref> from coach [[Gregg Berhalter]].

==International career==
Borso was called up to the United States U19s training camps in 2025<ref>{{Cite web |last=chicagofirefc |title=Homegrown Player Dylan Borso Called Up to U.S. U-20 Men's National Team for September Domestic Training Camp {{!}} Chicago Fire FC |url=https://www.chicagofirefc.com/news/homegrown-player-dylan-borso-called-up-to-u-s-u-20-men-s-national-team-for-september-domestic-training-camp |access-date=2026-07-17 |website=chicagofirefc |language=en}}</ref> and the U20s for competition in Argentina<ref>{{Cite web |last=chicagofirefc |title=Four Chicago Fire FC Players Called to National Team Duty {{!}} Chicago Fire FC |url=https://www.chicagofirefc.com/news/four-chicago-fire-fc-players-called-to-national-team-duty |access-date=2026-07-17 |website=chicagofirefc |language=en}}</ref> and Bosnia where he played winger<ref>{{Cite web |last=and Alex Calabrese |date=2026-03-25 |title=Every Chicago Fire International Call-Up This March |url=https://www.meninred97.com/every-chicago-fire-international-call-up-this-march/ |access-date=2026-07-17 |website=MIR97 Media |language=en}}</ref> in 2026.  [[Lionel Messi]] was pitch side for Borso's assist in the American's 3–0 victory against Argentina's U20s in Buenos Aires.<ref>{{Cite news |date=2026-03-28 |title=American Ultras Talk (@usmntaut) on X |url=https://x.com/usmntaut/status/2037910964524159366 |access-date=2026-07-17 |work=X (formerly Twitter) |language=en-US}}</ref>

On 28 May 2025, Motherwell announced that they had again extended their contract with Whyte.{{cite web |title=2024/25 end of season squad update |url=https://www.motherwellfc.co.uk/2025/05/28/2024-25-end-of-season-squad-update/ |website=motherwellfc.co.uk |publisher=Motherwell F.C. |access-date=28 May 2025 |date=28 May 2025}} On 7 August 2025,
